payload.supporting_quote: Two studies examined interleukin 1 beta (IL-β), none of which found a significant difference in IL-β levels between NSLBP groups and controls.

payload.comparison_population: non-specific low back pain vs healthy control
payload.supporting_quote: Interleukin-1 beta (IL-1β), interleukin-17 (IL-17), interferon gamma (IFN-γ), and high-sensitivity CRP (hsCRP) showed no significant differences.
The WOND and WND groups showed significantly higher expression of IL-1β (P < 0.001) and IL-4 (P = 0.034, P < 0.001) when compared with healthy controls.
